actors.name: Amara
actors.private_context: Amara is a professional who cares about her reputation among coworkers. She has no specific knowledge of how her coworkers currently perceive her, but she hopes to earn more respect by the end of the quarter.

actors.name: Coworker 1
actors.private_context: A coworker of Amara. Has their own impressions of Amara based on past interactions, but these are not specified. May notice Amara's actions over the quarter.

actors.name: Coworker 2
actors.private_context: Another coworker of Amara. Similarly has existing impressions and may observe Amara's behavior.

actors.name: Coworker 3
actors.private_context: A third coworker of Amara. May also form or change opinions based on Amara's actions.

shared_context: Amara and her coworkers work together in the same organization. They interact regularly in the workplace. Respect is a subjective assessment that coworkers may form based on Amara's actions, competence, and behavior over time.

starting_events.description: The quarter begins. Amara and her coworkers start their workday.

resolution: Resolve YES only if, by the hard cutoff, there is observable evidence (e.g., a coworker explicitly states increased respect, Amara receives a promotion or positive performance review citing respect, or a reliable survey or feedback mechanism records higher respect) that Amara's coworkers respect her more than at the start. Otherwise resolve NO.
